steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: How do you feel? All better now, right?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm fine...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm totally fine, I'm sure of it. The both of us are.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm going out for a bit, so stay put here.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: You're going out again the moment you feel a little better?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I've got work to do.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: That's fine and all, but shouldn't you at least wait until you've recovered?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't worry about me.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hibiscus said the same thing. After you wake up, it'd be best to keep resting for a while and monitoring your condition.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It's an emergency, one that can't wait. Alright?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But, there's not a whole lot of time left until the concert. I think the most important to do until then is to make sure you're healthy and well-practiced... I'm sure that's what you want too.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Can you stop pestering me with that right now?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Pestering?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But I have to go, so don't get in my way. I'll be back as soon as I can.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: And you really... can't tell me what you're going to do?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If everything goes well... you'll know soon enough.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Oh right, your suit.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: What about it?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I made an appointment to pick it up this afternoon, but I won't be able to go with you. You should go get it yourself.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Remember to bring your cello with you and play a little passage as you're trying it on. Make sure there aren't any areas that feel uncomfortable.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You again?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Yes, it's me.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm here to ask you to put this concert on hold. Or at least, don't let Ebenholz and Kreide play together.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Something terrible is going to happen in the Afterglow if those two play together!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: So if what you're saying is true, my recent improvement was due to this so-called 'false recovery' caused by Ebenholz and Kreide. And as soon as this phase is over, I'll become critically ill and my life will be in danger.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's right. You've been around them a lot, so the symptoms will also be a lot more pronounced.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Others who've had less contact with them are also affected, and if I let the two of them play together, there's a high possibility that people will die?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Correct. Even though I don't know the exact reason, having the two play together seems to amplify the effect they have on their surroundings.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: How likely are we talking about here?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I can't say for sure right now...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Other than me, who else is in life-threatening danger?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Over a dozen people from the Afterglow have already been hospitalized in the Cliffy Patio.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: The Cliffy Patio... In other words, they've already left Ebenholz and Kreide's effective range?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That should be the case.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Then I have a clear picture of the situation.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your answer...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: ...is no.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm not asking you to cancel the whole concert. You can just cut Ebenholz and Kreide's part, or even have someone else perform the duet!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: If you can prove that their duet will cause harm to people other than me, then I'll cancel the concert right away.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But it seems that's not the case. Even you have no idea what would happen if they played together. I can't simply throw away the efforts and aspirations of everyone in the Afterglow over these illusory 'concerns.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The efforts and aspirations...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I understand how much this concert means to you, but...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You don't understand anything.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: If you truly understood, you wouldn't throw around the word 'but' so lightly.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Unfortunately, I cannot change the concert schedule on your word alone.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny, please give me a straight answer. What makes this concert more important than the lives of the Infected?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Are you suggesting that I'm disregarding peoples' lives?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm just saying––

steps.name: Ursula
steps.text: Hibiscus! Hibiscus!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ms. Ursula?

steps.name: Ursula
steps.text: Come take a little stroll, won't you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Ursula
steps.text: Come now.

steps.name: Ursula
steps.text: Let's head out and calm down first. We can talk about this later, okay?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (If everything Gertrude said is true, then Kreide won't survive this.)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (No, there must be some way... Some way to come out ahead on both fronts...)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Czerny, Czerny must know something...)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (No, he's just a musician, he won't be able to help.)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Should I tell Kreide the truth––)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (But what good would that do?)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Rhodes Island...)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Someone like Hibiscus is only going to send me back to my cell in Urtica!)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (The Empresses' Voice?)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (What am I even thinking? Is this a suicide mission?!)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (No, I've been going in circles. I'm standing out too much. I need to go somewhere less crowded.)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Huh? Have I seen that man before?)

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Definitely... the crowd.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Right, the rumor. There was that rumor!)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (I've got to get to the bottom of this rumor. Who knows, there might even be some clues, or the person spreading the rumor might know something!)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (But it's all up to me at this point...)

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: This is the best opportunity we're going to get.

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: The longer things drag on, the less time we'll have. It'll only make things harder.

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: Alright, hurry it up then. I'll go report to the higher-ups. I'm counting on you, Herr Lachmann.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Heh. This work sure is demanding, physically and emotionally.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: It's hard enough spreading the rumors. Now I even have to go THERE...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (The sewers? He's heading into the sewers?)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (I'd rather not have to follow him down there... Time to act.)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Hold it right there.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Who are you?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't turn around.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Tell me, who sent you to spread rumors in the Afterglow?

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: You've got the wrong idea, I just happened to overhear...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I've been following you the whole time, Herr Lachmann.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And I connected the dots just now. You were one fanning the flames before, spreading rumors to have that mob accost Hibiscus.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: You've got a pretty good memory.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Speak. Who sent you here, and what were you planning to do in the sewers?
What wonderful timing. I am also quite curious as to what Herr Lachmann planned to do in the sewers.
Don't turn around, or else...
What do you think will happen?
